'''Tennah Steph''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Voss]], she owned a small shop she they bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics.
